en: Off for a walk?
It's really turned cold, hasn't it?
I'm Rhoda. I work at the factory.
you know...
note: Follows #9465 (slice 118) 'has come to feel harder and harder,' as that slice's note asks.

en: You've got a bright future ahead of you.
My son...
If he'd lived, would he have grown into a fine
young man like you, too, I wonder?
Find someone to share your life with, too,
and be happy, won't you?

note: Nine dots shown as '...'. Shared: Rhoda, Pauline (silent child), and the player's silent reply to Clio.

en: , what are you doing here?
Just now,
I was having a dream.
note: Follows #9532 after a pause on the same line: leading space.

en: My son, who died, was alive after all,
and he called me "Mother."
Isn't it a coincidence? My son was named
too.
My mother
died when I was born.
So I have no memories of a mother at all.
Please,
Just once, that's all.
Call me "Mother,"
and give me a kiss.
...All right.
Mother.
Th-thank you...
I'm so happy...
S-somehow I feel
as if I'm slipping away.
Mother... I wish someone I could call mother
had lived for me, too.
, my master... Now, give me your orders...
I'll obey anything you say...
Yesterday I woke up to blood on my pillow!
But I haven't got a single cut on me.
What on earth could it be?
Command me as you wish...
Please feel free to look around the shop.
Hmm. Soap is soap, yet there are a great
many kinds of it, I see.
Oh yes, there are!
We've got antiseptic ones for staying clean,
and elegantly scented ones for the ladies.
We carry all sorts.
Please pick whichever you like.
We're open.
Please, feel free to look around the shop.
Just looking is fine, so do come again.
Welcome! Thank you, as always.
Some new products came in today.
They're on the shelf over there.
Even ordinary Londoners have caught on to
hygiene these days, so soap is a very
popular item.
If anything takes your fancy, please don't
hesitate to ask.
Oh, welcome! Thank you, as always.
We do appreciate your custom.
Londoners today wash their hands and faces
properly with soap and keep themselves
groomed. That's how a gentleman should be.
You really must try this new product, too.
It smells so fresh, and it
washes wonderfully!
note: Joined to #9584 on the same line with no separator, so the leading space is needed.

en: Is my way of selling a bit pushy?
I think it's normal, but Cecil says
I'm practically forcing things on people.
Cecil's way of selling just won't do.
For the customers' sake, too, you've got to
recommend good products properly.
Oh, what is it?
The shop isn't open.
Please come back later.
...is what I'd like to say, but
we're still getting the shop ready. Sorry.
Please come while the shop is open.
How kind of you to come.
I'm afraid we're in the middle of stocktaking.
